title: Volcanoes of Japan
intro: 10 volcanoes of Japan, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Akusekijima
rounds.fact: Akusekijima is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 584 m in the source data. The data places it in Japan.

rounds.name: Hokkaido-Komagatake
